summary: Verified Module 1 FIX end-to-end for cache behavior, image contents, and runtime health using the current multi-stage Dockerfile and .dockerignore.
evidence: Rebuild after source-only change kept dependency layer cached: second build showed `RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --prefix=/install -r requirements.txt` as CACHED.
Sensitive files excluded from image: `docker run --rm myservice-fixcheck sh -c "test -f /app/.env ...; test -d /app/.git ..."` returned ENV_ABSENT and GIT_ABSENT.
Container health endpoints passed: startup poll returned LIVE 200 READY 200 for /live and /ready.
Container reached healthy status and runs non-root: `docker ps` showed healthy and `docker exec ... whoami` returned appuser.
Image size evidence recorded: `docker images myservice-fixcheck --format "{{.Repository}} {{.Tag}} {{.Size}}"` returned 269MB.
